description: Go source code for a test scanner and fuzzer for BN (big number) operations, specifically handling quotient and modular exponentiation tests, generating fuzzing corpus files.

classes.name: test
classes.description: Represents a test case with line number, type, and associated big.Int values.

classes.name: testScanner
classes.description: Scanner for parsing test definitions from input files, with methods for scanning lines, adding attributes, and retrieving test data.

methods.name: newTestScanner
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new testScanner from an io.Reader.

methods.name: scanLine
methods.description: Advances the scanner by one line.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Parses a line into a key-value attribute, storing it in the current test.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Reads and parses the next test case from input.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Returns the current parsed test case.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns any error encountered during scanning.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error with line number context.
